author: Yffe
content: Failing test pinned at thermite-lower/tests/divergence_struct_inv_cast_lt.rs::struct_invariant_cast_lt_is_parenthesized (#[ignore]'d, blocker #148). Repro: `struct Gauge { x: u64, cap: u64, } inv (x as u32) < cap` → thermite_lower::lower emits the bare `self.x as u32 < self.cap`; forge check → L0 `error: expected ,` (the #146 generic mis-parse). Root cause: lower_inv_operand (the struct type-invariant operand parenthesizer, REQ-8 well_formed path) lacks the cast-< paren guard that lower_binary_operand got in 167b9f4 (is_lt_leading). Same class as #146, separate code path. lower_binary_operand-path clauses (fn req/ens/loop-inv, what forge tv checks) ARE fixed — verified (x as u32) < 33 parenthesizes there.
